macros.name: AKA
macros.doc: The also known as macro and its starred form display an alias in the text and create a cross-reference in the index.

macros.name: AllCapsActive
macros.doc: Turn on global surname capitalization.

macros.name: AllCapsInactive
macros.doc: Turn off global surname capitalization.

macros.name: AltFormatInactive
macros.doc: Turn off alternate formatting altogether.

macros.name: CapName
macros.doc: The macro \CapName overrides the ⟨SNN⟩ created by \CapThis, effectively nullifying its effects.

macros.name: CapThis
macros.doc: Capitalize first letter of all name components.

macros.name: DropAffix
macros.doc: Drop affix only for a long Western name instance.

macros.name: ExcludeName
macros.doc: Unlike \IndexInactive and \IndexActive, which affect all nameauth indexing, \ExcludeName only excludes a specific name from being printed as a page entry or cross-reference in the index.

macros.name: FixateFormat
macros.doc: \FixateFormat works only within AltFormatZone and AltFormatZone* to prevent the format switches from making any changes.

macros.name: ForceAffix
macros.doc: In subsequent uses of a Western name, the prefix macro \ForceAffix allows one to print just ⟨Affix⟩ by itself.

macros.name: ForceFN
macros.doc: Print ⟨Affix⟩ or ⟨Alternate⟩ in a Non-Western short name.

macros.name: ForceName
macros.doc: Force first-use formatting hooks.

macros.name: ForgetName
macros.doc: This macro “forgets” a name by deleting its pattern.

macros.name: FrontNameHook
macros.doc: Used for subsequent instances of names in front-matter text.

macros.name: GlobalNameTest
macros.doc: Causes decision paths in the name decision macros to have no scoping.

macros.name: IfFrontName
macros.doc: This macro expands one path if a front matter name exists, or else the other.

macros.name: IndexActive
macros.doc: Turn on global indexing of names.

macros.name: IndexActual
macros.doc: Change the “actual” character from the default.

macros.name: IndexInactive
macros.doc: \IndexInactive deactivates the indexing functions of the naming macros, as well as \IndexName, and \IndexRef.

macros.name: IndexProtect
macros.doc: One can use \IndexProtect right before \printindex to protect the index against bogus output.

macros.name: IndexWarnTerse
macros.doc: Turn off verbose warnings for indexing.

macros.name: IndexWarnVerbose
macros.doc: Turn on verbose warnings for indexing.

macros.name: KeepAffix
macros.doc: \KeepAffix Insert non-breaking space between ⟨SNN⟩, ⟨FNN/Affix⟩.

macros.name: KeepName
macros.doc: In longer name forms, \KeepName turns spaces between all visible name elements into non-breaking spaces.

macros.name: LocalNameTest
macros.doc: Causes decision paths in the name decision macros to be in a local scope.

macros.name: NameAddInfo
macros.doc: \NameAddInfo will replace one name tag with another name tag, but it does not delete a tag.

macros.name: NameauthIndex
macros.doc: \NameauthIndex is the indexing hook defined by default as \index.

macros.name: NameauthName
macros.doc: \NameauthName Hook called when no special name modification is made.

macros.name: NameClearInfo
macros.doc: This deletes a text tag.

macros.name: NamesActive
macros.doc: \NamesActive switches names to the main-matter system.

macros.name: NamesInactive
macros.doc: \NamesInactive and the frontmatter option enable the front-matter system.

macros.name: NoComma
macros.doc: No comma between ⟨SNN⟩ and ⟨Affix⟩.

macros.name: ReverseActive
macros.doc: Turn on global name reversing.

macros.name: ReverseCommaActive
macros.doc: Turn on global “last-name-comma-first”.

macros.name: ReverseCommaInactive
macros.doc: Turn off global “last-name-comma-first”.

macros.name: ReverseInactive
macros.doc: Turn off global name reversing.

macros.name: RevName
macros.doc: Reverse order of any name.

macros.name: SeeAlso
macros.doc: For \IndexName, \AKA, and \PName; make a see also xref.

macros.name: ShowComma
macros.doc: In a long name form, \ShowComma forces the display of a comma between a Western name and its affix.

macros.name: ShowIdxPageref
macros.doc: \ShowIdxPageref shows how macro arguments generate an index page reference, regardless of whether or not that page reference or cross-reference actually exists.

macros.name: SkipIndex
macros.doc: For naming macros; do not create index entry.

macros.name: SubvertName
macros.doc: This macro “subverts” a name by creating a name pattern.

macros.name: SubvertThis
macros.doc: Force subsequent name instance.

macros.name: textIT
macros.doc: Alternate formatting macro: italic when active.

macros.name: textUC
macros.doc: Alternate formatting macro: uppercase when active.
